specName: Banking Rework — Undeposited Funds, Petty Cash, Deposits and Cash Withdrawals
request: There needs to be some major changes made to the banking system. Create a new branch and spec to address this and refer to issue #368. Present the spec for approval before moving to the planning stage.

decisions.decision: Card and EFT receipts go straight to a bank account chosen at entry, not the holding account
One cash account: the existing Cash on Hand system account is renamed Petty Cash; cash takings and float withdrawals both land in it
A mistaken deposit is corrected by reversing the whole deposit, returning its cheques to awaiting deposit and its cash to Petty Cash
Undeposited Funds is system account 1105 with id ...0008, not a bank account
decisions.why: 1101-1109 are never auto-assigned so the unique AccountNumber index cannot collide; IsSystem keeps it out of organisation history
decisions.rejected: a number from 1110 up, which user bank accounts can already hold

decisions.decision: A new ReceivedItem entity, one per payment or income entry, with derived awaiting state
decisions.why: Payment and JournalEntry are immutable and payments write one GL line per fee
decisions.rejected: status columns on Payment or JournalEntry

decisions.decision: BankDeposit plus BankDepositLine entities; reversal is a BankDepositReversal journal entry linked once
decisions.why: keeps the GL immutable and gives one bank line per deposit
decisions.rejected: deriving deposit contents from GL lines alone

decisions.decision: Cash withdrawal is only a CashWithdrawal journal entry
decisions.why: it has no state beyond its entry and is corrected by a deposit

decisions.decision: Static pure ReceiptRouting function shared by PaymentService and IncomeEntryService
decisions.why: a stateless rule with two callers needs no injected interface
decisions.rejected: an injected router service with one implementation

decisions.decision: Backup 1.4.0 uses envelope members 29, 31 and 32 and re-applies the Petty Cash name for older files
decisions.why: 27, 28 and 30 are taken and upsert restores the old Cash on Hand name
decisions.rejected: always overwriting system account names on restore

decisions.decision: BankingService replaces BankDepositService; old route kept as a second @page on BankingPage
decisions.why: the typed-amount deposit no longer exists and a second route is the simplest redirect
decisions.rejected: a stub redirect page or keeping both services

expectations: Card-terminal settlement batches and their fees
Linking a cash withdrawal or float to a specific event
Reclassifying historical payments posted to Cash on Hand
A separate float account apart from Petty Cash
context: area: src/StageFright.Core/Modules/Finance (BankDepositService, PaymentService, IncomeEntryService, ExpensePaymentService, SystemAccounts)
area: src/StageFright.Core/Modules/Rehearsals/AttendanceService (cash fee payments post to Cash on Hand)
area: src/StageFright.UI/Pages/Finance (BankDepositPage, PaymentForm, RecordIncome) and FinanceMenuItemProvider
area: StageFrightDbContext seeded system accounts 1100 Cash on Hand (IsBankAccount) and 1200 Member Receivable
finding: every member payment currently debits Cash on Hand regardless of PaymentMethod
finding: spec 009 defines the current deposit flow (Cash on Hand to a chosen bank account, typed amount)
constraint: financial records immutable, GL balanced in one transaction, corrections by reversing pairs
constraint: every new neutral resx key translated into all 7 shipped cultures; money via MoneyFormatter
constraint: DebugDataSeeder must cover 2+ years after a schema change
constraint: backup protobuf members append-only; spec 032 also bumps the backup version

FR-001.title: Undeposited Funds system asset account, auto-created, not deletable, not a bank account

FR-002.title: Cash on Hand renamed Petty Cash, keeping number, history and balance

FR-003.title: Member payments routed by method: cash to Petty Cash, cheque/other to Undeposited Funds, card/EFT to chosen bank

FR-004.title: Income entry asks how money was received and routes by the same rules

FR-005.title: Rehearsal cash fee payments go to Petty Cash

FR-006.title: Optional cheque reference shown wherever the cheque is listed

FR-007.title: Banking menu item replaces Record Bank Deposit, opening the Banking screen

FR-008.title: Awaiting-deposit list shows date, payer, reference, amount and total

FR-009.title: Record a deposit of selected cheques plus optional cash into one bank account

FR-010.title: Deposit validation: non-empty, cash within Petty Cash balance, cheques still awaiting, date not before receipt

FR-011.title: Running deposit total split into cash and cheques

FR-012.title: Deposit posts one balanced all-or-nothing entry and marks cheques deposited

FR-013.title: Each deposit is a single reconciliation line for its full total

FR-014.title: Record a cash withdrawal from a bank account into Petty Cash

FR-015.title: Banking history of deposits and withdrawals with deposit detail

FR-016.title: Reverse a deposit once: opposite entries, cheques back to awaiting, marked reversed

FR-017.title: Mistaken withdrawal corrected by depositing the cash back

FR-018.title: Deposits, withdrawals and reversals respect closed financial periods

FR-019.title: Audit trail entry for every deposit, withdrawal and reversal

FR-020.title: Existing financial records are not changed or reclassified

FR-021.title: Historical bank deposit and transfer entries still report correctly

FR-022.title: Backup includes and restores the new banking records; older backups still restore

FR-023.title: New text fully translated; amounts use configured currency

FR-024.title: Debug sample data covers 2+ years of the new banking flows, balanced

intent: Rework banking so cheques wait in Undeposited Funds, cash goes to Petty Cash, deposits clear selected items into the bank, and cash can be withdrawn as event floats

verified.result: [plan-check] plan.md: 3 call paths, 14 lines, 2 screens, 22 parts, 2 state blocks (4 states). Every cited file and line checks out.

plan.summary: Plan, research and data model written for the banking rework
plan.key_finding: Restore upserts by id and never deletes, so an old backup reverts the Petty Cash name but keeps Undeposited Funds

approach: Route each receipt by payment method through a pure ReceiptRouting rule, track cheques as ReceivedItem rows, and post deposits, reversals and withdrawals as balanced journal entries through a new BankingService. One migration renames 1100 and seeds 1105, and backup moves to 1.4.0.
